---
title: "06_land_use_Biodiv_plots"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

# ── 1. Load and combine ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
areas_dir <- here::here("BES_results", "results_biodiversity", "cSAR_iDiv")

areas_paths <- list.files(areas_dir, pattern = "^areas_.*\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

# Keep only the most recent run (2020-2050 prefix in name, dated 23062026) to
# avoid mixing an older 18062026 extraction in with the newer scenario runs
areas_paths_2050 <- areas_paths[grepl("23062026", areas_paths)]

areas_all <- areas_paths_2050 |>
  set_names(basename) |>
  map(\(f) read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE)) |>
  list_rbind(names_to = "filename") |>
  mutate(
    parts    = str_split(filename, "_"),
    scenario = map_chr(parts, 2),   # areas_{scenario}_{model}_{date}.csv
    # SSP2RCP6 is the 2020-2050 re-run of the Baseline scenario — relabel to BAU
    # so it lines up with the BAU label used everywhere else
    scenario = if_else(scenario == "SSP2RCP6", "BAU", scenario),
    model    = map_chr(parts, 3)
  ) |>
  select(-filename, -`...1`, -parts)

# ── 2. Filter Global + pivot long ─────────────────────────────────────────────
areas_long <- areas_all |>
  filter(zone_type == "Global") |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = starts_with("area_"),
    names_to  = "year",
    names_prefix = "area_",
    values_to = "area_km2"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    year     = as.integer(year),
    scenario = factor(scenario, levels = c("BAU", "NaC", "NfN", "NfS"))
  )

# ── 3. Plot ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
scenario_cols <- c(
  "BAU"  = "#E63946",
  "NaC"  = "#457B9D",
  "NfN"  = "#2A9D8F",
  "NfS"  = "#E9C46A"
)

c <- ggplot(areas_long, aes(x = year, y = area_km2 / 1e6, colour = scenario, group = scenario)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ entity, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = scenario_cols) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(2020, 2030, 2050, 2070)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(suffix = " M")) +
  labs(
    title    = "Land-use area trends by entity — GLOBIO",
    subtitle = "Global zone · area in million km²",
    x        = NULL,
    y        = "Area (million km²)",
    colour   = "Scenario"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ entity, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3)+
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

c

ggsave(
  file.path(areas_dir, "trends_entities_GLOBIO_global.png"),
  width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 200
)
```
# decadal

```{r}
areas_decadal <- areas_long |>
  arrange(entity, scenario, year) |>
  group_by(entity, scenario) |>
  mutate(
    area_prev     = lag(area_km2),
    year_prev     = lag(year),
    n_decades     = (year - year_prev) / 10,
    change_per_dec = (area_km2 - area_prev) / (area_prev * n_decades) * 100
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(!is.na(change_per_dec))  # drops 2020 (no lag)
```

```{r}
ggplot(areas_decadal, aes(x = year, y = change_per_dec, colour = scenario, group = scenario)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
  facet_wrap(~ entity, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = scenario_cols) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(2030, 2050, 2070)) +
  labs(
    title    = "Land-use change per decade by entity — GLOBIO",
    subtitle = "Global zone · % change per decade relative to previous timestep",
    x        = NULL,
    y        = "Change per decade (%)",
    colour   = "Scenario"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(areas_dir, "trends_decadal_change_GLOBIO_global.png"),
  width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 200
)
```
